verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּבָנֶ֤יךָ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ וּבֵית־ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- ’a·hă·rōn ’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’it·tāḵ ū·ḇêṯ- tiś·’ū ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn ham·miq·dāš wə·’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ’it·tāḵ tiś·’ū ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn kə·hun·naṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: So the LORD said to Aaron You and your sons and your father’s . . . house must bear - the iniquity [involving] the sanctuary And you and your sons [alone] must bear - the iniquity [involving] your priesthood

verses.original: הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔ךְ וְגַ֣ם אֶת־ אַחֶיךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְיִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖יךָ וִֽישָׁרְת֑וּךָ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃
verses.transliteration: haq·rêḇ ’it·tāḵ wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ’a·ḥe·ḵā maṭ·ṭêh lê·wî šê·ḇeṭ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·yil·lā·wū ‘ā·le·ḵā wî·šā·rə·ṯū·ḵā wə·’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ’it·tāḵ lip̄·nê ’ō·hel hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ
verses.literal: But bring with you also your brothers from the tribe of Levi the tribe of your father that they may join you and assist you and your sons . . . before the Tent of the Testimony

verses.original: וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּךָ֔ וּמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כָּל־ הָאֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל־ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ כְּלֵ֨י הַקֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וְלֹֽא־ גַם־ הֵ֖ם גַּם־ אַתֶּֽם׃ יָמֻ֥תוּ
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū miš·mar·tə·ḵā ū·miš·me·reṯ kāl- hā·’ō·hel ’aḵ ’el- lō yiq·rā·ḇū kə·lê haq·qō·ḏeš wə·’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·lō- ḡam- hêm gam- ’at·tem yā·mu·ṯū
verses.literal: And they shall attend to your duties and to all the duties . . . of the Tent . . . but they must not come near to the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar or both they and you will die

verses.original: וְנִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְשָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל לֹא־ וְזָ֖ר יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nil·wū ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ hā·’ō·hel lō- wə·zār yiq·raḇ ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: They are to join you and attend to the duties of the Tent of Meeting doing all the work at the Tent but no outsider may come near you

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ קֶ֖צֶף וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ע֛וֹד
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’êṯ miš·me·reṯ haq·qō·ḏeš wə·’êṯ miš·me·reṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ qe·ṣep̄ wə·lō- yih·yeh ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary [and] of the altar so that wrath may not fall on the Israelites . . . again

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה וַאֲנִ֗י לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מַתָּנָ֤ה לָכֶ֞ם נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh wa·’ă·nî lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥê·ḵem hal·wî·yim mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mat·tā·nāh lā·ḵem nə·ṯu·nîm Yah·weh la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Behold I Myself have selected - your fellow Levites from the Israelites . . . as a gift to you dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִ֠תְּךָ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת־ כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֜ם לְכָל־ דְּבַ֧ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּלְמִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹ֖כֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֣ת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֔ם מַתָּנָ֗ה וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ’it·tə·ḵā tiš·mə·rū ’eṯ- kə·hun·naṯ·ḵem lə·ḵāl də·ḇar ham·miz·bê·aḥ ū·lə·mib·bêṯ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’et·tên ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ kə·hun·naṯ·ḵem mat·tā·nāh wə·haz·zār haq·qā·rêḇ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: But only you and your sons . . . shall attend - to your priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil and you are to perform that service I am giving - you the work of the priesthood as a gift but any outsider who comes near [the sanctuary] must be put to death

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֒ הִנֵּ֣ה וַאֲנִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֔ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑י לְכָל־ קָדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל נְתַתִּ֧ים לְךָ֨ וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ לְמָשְׁחָ֛ה עוֹלָֽם׃ לְחָק־
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn hin·nêh wa·’ă·nî nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ tə·rū·mō·ṯāy lə·ḵāl qā·ḏə·šê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl nə·ṯat·tîm lə·ḵā ū·lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā lə·mā·šə·ḥāh ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḥāq-
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Aaron Behold I have put you - in charge of My offerings As for all the sacred offerings vvv of the Israelites I have given them to you and your sons as a portion and a permanent statute

verses.original: זֶֽה־ מִן־ מִקֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים הָאֵ֑שׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ כָּל־ קָ֠רְבָּנָם לְֽכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים מִנְחָתָ֞ם וּלְכָל־ חַטָּאתָ֗ם וּלְכָל־ אֲשָׁמָם֙ ה֖וּא לְךָ֛ וּלְבָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: zeh- min- miq·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm hā·’êš yih·yeh lə·ḵā kāl- qā·rə·bā·nām lə·ḵāl ’ă·šer yā·šî·ḇū lî qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm min·ḥā·ṯām ū·lə·ḵāl- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām ū·lə·ḵāl- ’ă·šā·mām hū lə·ḵā ū·lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: - A portion of the most holy offerings . . . [reserved] from the fire will be yours From all the offerings . . . - they render to Me as most holy [offerings] . . . whether grain offerings . . . or sin offerings . . . or guilt offerings [that part] belongs to you and your sons

verses.original: תֹּאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ בְּקֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים כָּל־ זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹת֔וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tō·ḵă·len·nū bə·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm kāl- zā·ḵār yō·ḵal ’ō·ṯōw yih·yeh- qō·ḏeš lāḵ
verses.literal: You are to eat it as a most holy [offering] . . . [and] every male may eat it You shall regard it as holy -

verses.original: וְזֶה־ לְּךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ם לְכָל־ תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ נְתַתִּ֗ים לְךָ֣ וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ עוֹלָ֑ם לְחָק־ כָּל־ טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh- lə·ḵā tə·rū·maṯ mat·tā·nām lə·ḵāl tə·nū·p̄ōṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl nə·ṯat·tîm lə·ḵā ū·lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā wə·liḇ·nō·ṯe·ḵā ’it·tə·ḵā ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḥāq- kāl- ṭā·hō·wr bə·ḇê·ṯə·ḵā yō·ḵal ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: And this is yours as well the offering of their gifts along with all the wave offerings vvv of the Israelites I have given this to you and your sons and daughters . . . as a permanent statute Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat it -

verses.original: יִתְּנ֥וּ כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְכָל־ חֵ֖לֶב תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְדָגָ֑ן אֲשֶׁר־ נְתַתִּֽים׃ לַֽיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֥ רֵאשִׁיתָ֛ם
verses.transliteration: yit·tə·nū kōl ḥê·leḇ yiṣ·hār wə·ḵāl ḥê·leḇ tî·rō·wōš wə·ḏā·ḡān ’ă·šer- nə·ṯat·tîm Yah·weh lə·ḵā rê·šî·ṯām
verses.literal: I give you all the freshest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain that the Israelites give to the LORD as their firstfruits

verses.original: בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאַרְצָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ יָבִ֥יאוּ לַיהוָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֑ה לְךָ֣ כָּל־ טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bik·kū·rê kāl- ’ă·šer bə·’ar·ṣām ’ă·šer- yā·ḇî·’ū Yah·weh yih·yeh lə·ḵā kāl- ṭā·hō·wr bə·ḇê·ṯə·ḵā yō·ḵă·len·nū
verses.literal: The firstfruits of everything - in their land that they bring to the LORD will belong to you Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat them

verses.original: כָּל־ חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ḥê·rem bə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵā yih·yeh
verses.literal: Every devoted thing in Israel belongs to you

verses.original: פֶּ֣טֶר רֶ֠חֶם לְֽכָל־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ בָּאָדָ֥ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה יַקְרִ֧יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֛ה יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ׀ פָּדֹ֣ה תִפְדֶּ֗ה אֵ֚ת בְּכ֣וֹר הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְאֵ֛ת תִּפְדֶּֽה׃ בְּכֽוֹר־ הַטְּמֵאָ֖ה הַבְּהֵמָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: pe·ṭer re·ḥem lə·ḵāl kāl- bā·śār ’ă·šer- bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh yaq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh yih·yeh- lāḵ ’aḵ pā·ḏōh ṯip̄·deh ’êṯ bə·ḵō·wr hā·’ā·ḏām wə·’êṯ tip̄·deh bə·ḵō·wr- haṭ·ṭə·mê·’āh hab·bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: The firstborn . . . . . . of every womb whether man or beast that is offered to the LORD belongs to you But you must surely redeem . . . - every firstborn son - [and] every firstborn male of unclean animals

verses.original: וּפְדוּיָו֙ מִבֶּן־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֨רְכְּךָ֔ חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כֶּ֛סֶף הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הֽוּא׃ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·ḏū·yāw mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš tip̄·deh bə·‘er·kə·ḵā ḥă·mê·šeṯ šə·qā·lîm ke·sep̄ haq·qō·ḏeš bə·še·qel hū ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh
verses.literal: You are to pay the redemption price for a month-old male . . . . . . according to your valuation five shekels of silver according to the sanctuary shekel which is twenty gerahs

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה בְּֽכוֹר־ שׁ֡וֹר כֶּ֜שֶׂב אֽוֹ־ בְכ֥וֹר אֽוֹ־ בְכ֨וֹר עֵ֛ז הֵ֑ם אֶת־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּזְרֹ֤ק דָּמָ֞ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וְאֶת־ תַּקְטִ֔יר חֶלְבָּ֣ם אִשֶּׁ֛ה נִיחֹ֖חַ לְרֵ֥יחַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō ṯip̄·deh bə·ḵō·wr- šō·wr ke·śeḇ ’ōw- ḇə·ḵō·wr ’ōw- ḇə·ḵō·wr ‘êz hêm ’eṯ- qō·ḏeš tiz·rōq dā·mām ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·’eṯ- taq·ṭîr ḥel·bām ’iš·šeh nî·ḥō·aḥ lə·rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox a sheep . . . . . . or . . . a goat they - are holy You are to splatter their blood on the altar - and burn their fat as a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וּבְשָׂרָ֖ם יִהְיֶה־ לָּ֑ךְ כַּחֲזֵ֧ה הַיָּמִ֖ין וּכְשׁ֥וֹק הַתְּנוּפָ֛ה יִהְיֶֽה׃ לְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·śā·rām yih·yeh- lāḵ ka·ḥă·zêh hay·yā·mîn ū·ḵə·šō·wq hat·tə·nū·p̄āh yih·yeh lə·ḵā
verses.literal: And their meat belongs to you just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל׀ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים תְּרוּמֹ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ יָרִ֥ימוּ לַֽיהוָה֒ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֗ וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ עוֹלָ֑ם לְחָק־ הִוא֙ עוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֩ מֶ֨לַח לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōl haq·qo·ḏā·šîm tə·rū·mōṯ ’ă·šer ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl yā·rî·mū Yah·weh nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ū·lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā wə·liḇ·nō·ṯe·ḵā ’it·tə·ḵā ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḥāq- hî ‘ō·w·lām bə·rîṯ me·laḥ lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·ḵā ū·lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: All the holy offerings that vvv the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and to your sons and daughters . . . as a permanent statute It is a permanent covenant of salt before the LORD for you and your offspring . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽל־ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֗ן לֹ֣א תִנְחָ֔ל בְּאַרְצָם֙ לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ וְחֵ֕לֶק בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer ’a·hă·rōn lō ṯin·ḥāl bə·’ar·ṣām lō- yih·yeh lə·ḵā wə·ḥê·leq bə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’ă·nî ḥel·qə·ḵā wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . said to Aaron You will have no inheritance in their land nor will you have any portion among them I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites . . .

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה נָתַ֛תִּי וְלִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י כָּל־ מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְנַחֲלָ֑ה חֵ֤לֶף עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֣ם עֹֽבְדִ֔ים אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tî wə·liḇ·nê lê·wî kāl- ma·‘ă·śêr bə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·na·ḥă·lāh ḥê·lep̄ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām ’ă·šer- hêm ‘ō·ḇə·ḏîm ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Behold I have given to the Levites . . . all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work - they do - the service of the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְלֹא־ ע֛וֹד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יִקְרְב֥וּ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לָשֵׂ֥את חֵ֖טְא לָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- yiq·rə·ḇū ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lā·śêṯ ḥêṭ lā·mūṯ
verses.literal: No longer may the Israelites . . . come near to the Tent of Meeting or they will incur guilt and die

verses.original: הַלֵּוִ֜י ה֗וּא אֶת־ וְעָבַ֨ד עֲבֹדַת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהֵ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ עֲוֺנָ֑ם עוֹלָם֙ חֻקַּ֤ת לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃ וּבְתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
verses.transliteration: hal·lê·wî hū ’eṯ- wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hêm yiś·’ū ‘ă·wō·nām ‘ō·w·lām ḥuq·qaṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem lō yin·ḥă·lū na·ḥă·lāh ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The Levites . . . - are to perform the work of the Tent of Meeting and they must bear their iniquity This is a permanent statute for the generations to come The Levites will not receive an inheritance . . . among the Israelites . . .

verses.original: כִּ֞י אֶת־ נָתַ֥תִּי לַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה מַעְשַׂ֣ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל יָרִ֤ימוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ תְּרוּמָ֔ה עַל־ כֵּן֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה׃פ בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- nā·ṯat·tî lal·wî·yim lə·na·ḥă·lāh ma‘·śar ’ă·šer bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl yā·rî·mū Yah·weh tə·rū·māh ‘al- kên ’ā·mar·tî lā·hem lō yin·ḥă·lū na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For - I have given to the Levites as their inheritance the tithe that the Israelites . . . present to the LORD as a contribution That is why . . . I told them . . . that they would not receive an inheritance . . . among the Israelites . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . instructed Moses . . .

verses.original: תְּדַבֵּר֮ וְאֶל־ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶם֒ כִּֽי־ תִ֠קְחוּ מֵאֵ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם מֵאִתָּ֖ם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶ֤ם מִן־ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר הַֽמַּעֲשֵֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḏab·bêr wə·’el- hal·wî·yim wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî- ṯiq·ḥū mê·’êṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ham·ma·‘ă·śêr ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem mê·’it·tām bə·na·ḥă·laṯ·ḵem wa·hă·rê·mō·ṯem min- mim·men·nū tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh ma·‘ă·śêr ham·ma·‘ă·śêr
verses.literal: Speak to the Levites and tell them . . . When you receive from the Israelites . . . - the tithe that I have given you . . . as your inheritance you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD a tithe of the tithe

verses.original: תְּרוּמַתְכֶ֑ם וְנֶחְשַׁ֥ב לָכֶ֖ם כַּדָּגָן֙ מִן־ הַגֹּ֔רֶן וְכַֽמְלֵאָ֖ה מִן־ הַיָּֽקֶב׃
verses.transliteration: tə·rū·maṯ·ḵem wə·neḥ·šaḇ lā·ḵem kad·dā·ḡān min- hag·gō·ren wə·ḵam·lê·’āh min- hay·yā·qeḇ
verses.literal: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן אַתֶּם֙ תָּרִ֤ימוּ גַם־ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְח֔וּ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ אֶת־ וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם יְהוָ֔ה תְּרוּמַ֣ת לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kên ’at·tem tā·rî·mū ḡam- tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh mik·kōl ma‘·śə·rō·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer tiq·ḥū mê·’êṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mim·men·nū ’eṯ- ū·nə·ṯat·tem Yah·weh tə·rū·maṯ lə·’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: So you are to present . . . an offering to the LORD from all the tithes - you receive . . . from the Israelites . . . and from [these] - you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest

verses.original: תָּרִ֕ימוּ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מִכָּל־ כָּל־ חֶלְבּ֔וֹ מִכֹּל֙ מַתְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֶֽת־ מִקְדְּשׁ֖וֹ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tā·rî·mū ’êṯ tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh mik·kāl kāl- ḥel·bōw mik·kōl mat·tə·nō·ṯê·ḵem ’eṯ- miq·də·šōw mim·men·nū
verses.literal: You must present - the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift - the holiest part of it

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֤ם אֶת־ חֶלְבּוֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כִּתְבוּאַ֥ת גֹּ֖רֶן וְכִתְבוּאַ֥ת יָֽקֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ba·hă·rî·mə·ḵem ’eṯ- ḥel·bōw mim·men·nū wə·neḥ·šaḇ lal·wî·yim kiṯ·ḇū·’aṯ gō·ren wə·ḵiṯ·ḇū·’aṯ yā·qeḇ
verses.literal: Therefore say to [the Levites] When you have presented - the best part - it will be reckoned [to you] as the produce of the threshing floor vvv or winepress

verses.original: אַתֶּ֖ם וּבֵֽיתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּכָל־ מָק֔וֹם הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם שָׂכָ֥ר חֵ֥לֶף עֲבֹֽדַתְכֶ֖ם בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tem ū·ḇê·ṯə·ḵem kî- wa·’ă·ḵal·tem ’ō·ṯōw bə·ḵāl mā·qō·wm hū lā·ḵem śā·ḵār ḥê·lep̄ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ·ḵem bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: And you and your households . . . may eat [the rest of it] anywhere - - . . . it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֥ם אֶת־ חֶלְבּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׂא֤וּ חֵ֔טְא עָלָיו֙ וְאֶת־ לֹ֥א תְחַלְּל֖וּ קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְלֹ֥א תָמֽוּתוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ba·hă·rî·mə·ḵem ’eṯ- ḥel·bōw mim·men·nū wə·lō- ṯiś·’ū ḥêṭ ‘ā·lāw wə·’eṯ- lō ṯə·ḥal·lə·lū qā·ḏə·šê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō ṯā·mū·ṯū
verses.literal: Once you have presented - the best part of it you will not incur guilt because of it But you must not defile the sacred offerings vvv of the Israelites or else you will die
